# Build Your Pillars

> Drink. Sleep. Move. Balance. A gentle way to notice your days, see your patterns and decide what works for you.

Track as much or as little as you want, without grades, streaks or judgment. Sharing with someone you trust is optional. Free for everyone 60 and over. Free for everyone else during the beta.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://buildyourpillars.com/): Notice your days and build what works for you. The home page explains the four pillars (Drink, Sleep, Move, Balance), the everyday benefit of logging a day your way, optional sharing, privacy, and where you can use it today.
- [How sharing works](https://buildyourpillars.com/sharing): Plain answers to the questions people ask first. You invite one person you trust, they have to say yes, you choose which pillars they see and how much, and you can pause or stop at any time. Sharing is for staying close. It does not detect falls or emergencies.
- [Why we built it](https://buildyourpillars.com/why): The story of two people, a husband and wife, who wanted a simple way to follow each other's days without confusion or pressure. Built by Bob Olmsted and Miah Shull Olmsted.
- [Privacy policy](https://buildyourpillars.com/privacy): What we collect and why, who else handles the data, where it is stored, how long we keep it, and how to download or delete your data.
- [Terms of use](https://buildyourpillars.com/terms): What the app is and is not, who can use it, what it costs, and how to use it fairly. It is for reflection. It is not medical advice.
- [Consumer health data privacy policy](https://buildyourpillars.com/health-data-privacy): What health information the app handles, who receives it, what we never do, and how to use your choices.

## Facts

- Four pillars, always in this order: Drink, Sleep, Move, Balance.
- A day without an entry is a Day off. Nothing is marked or counted.
- Built by Bob Olmsted and Miah Shull Olmsted. Owned by TransformingData, LLC, Spokane, WA, United States.
- Not a medical service, not a safety product, and not tied to any insurer or medical provider.
